links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT labor epidural answers with vs without structured CRAFT prompt
links.effect: CRAFT responses ranged from 6th to 9th grade versus 9th grade to college level for direct questions; significantly better readability.
links.quote: Responses generated using CRAFT-based prompt had significantly better readability than those with direct questions only.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT responses using structured prompt template versus direct questions
links.effect: Accuracy 99.8% ± 0.2% with CRAFT prompt vs 99.0% ± 0.4% with direct questions, P = 0.029; no difference in understandability or actionability.
links.quote: Accuracy was significantly higher in CRAFT-based prompt group than direct-question group (99.8% ± 0.2% vs. 99.0% ± 0.4%, P = 0.029).

unlisted_practices: Patient-facing use of structured user prompts (CRAFT framework) to personalize context, tone, and format of chatbot responses

links.effect: CRAFT responses 6th to 9th grade vs direct questions 9th grade to college level.
links.quote: The direct-question responses ranged from slightly difficult to professional (9th grade to college level), whereas the CRAFT-based prompt responses ranged from fairly easy to slightly difficult (6th to 9th grade).
